title: FAQ: Checking Account Referrals
summary: This FAQ covers Rho-Bank checking account referral rules: max 2 referral bonuses per rolling 9-day window; referred must be a new customer (no Rho-Bank accounts in past 12 months) and cannot share the same registered address; qualifying deposits are new money (external transfer, direct deposit, mobile check deposit, or branch cash/check). It also explains status meanings (COMPLETE/IN_PROGRESS/NO_PROGRESS/APPLIED/REJECTED/ERROR), common rejection reasons, rejection re-try timing, business referral eligibility (different primary owner), referral bonus clawback if the account closes within 90 days, promo stacking restrictions, and the qualifying-deposit timing (typically 60–120 days plus 30+ days to keep the funds).
faqs: How many referral bonuses can I receive in a rolling 9-day window?
Who is eligible to be referred (former customers, same address restrictions)?

Can I refer for a business checking account, and what owner restrictions apply?

external bank transfer / direct deposit / mobile check deposit / branch cash-check
referral statuses: COMPLETE, IN_PROGRESS, NO_PROGRESS, APPLIED, REJECTED, ERROR
